answer: A Sybil attacker wants cheap fake identities, so the economy prices identity itself. Each agent must lock a stake and accrue a public work log before it can earn; every new pseudonym has to harbor its own collateral and rebuild reputation from zero. Minting a thousand shills costs a thousand stakes plus a thousand re-proven histories, so expense grows linearly. Peers stamp attested proofs with an umber watermark tied to prior work, and honest agents stand out like ivory among clones that share one funding trace and collapse into a single node.
